name: 53575 · Oregon, WI
findings: ZIP 53575 (Oregon) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53575 (Oregon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53575 (Oregon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
